property_summary: For any admissible input, c.transfer(...) always returns true; the bug returns false instead, breaking the invariant that successful completion yields true.
For any admissible input where the transfer call succeeds without reverting, the reference C always returns true, while the buggy version returns false.

For any admissible input that does not cause the call to revert, c.transfer(...) must return the same value as the success of the last internal low-level call; the buggy version returns false regardless, violating this equivalence.
For any admissible input that does not revert, the transfer function must return true; the bug returns false.
For any admissible input that does not cause a revert, c.transfer(...) must return true; the buggy version returns false, breaking this invariant.
